mapper.select: SELECT album_no ,class_no ,content ,place ,album_date ,like_count FROM album ORDER BY album_no
SELECT a.album_no ,a.class_no ,a.content ,a.place ,a.album_date ,a.like_count FROM album a JOIN like b ON a.album_no = b.album_no WHERE b.member_id = #{memberId}
SELECT a.album_no ,a.class_no ,a.content ,a.place ,a.album_date ,a.like_count FROM album a WHERE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(a.album_date,'MM')) = #{month}
SELECT album_no ,class_no ,content ,place ,album_date ,like_count FROM album WHERE album_no = #{albumNo}
